name: Onion Powder

low.description: Not suitable - no safe serving size

siboNotes: High in fructans which feed SIBO bacteria and should be avoided completely during elimination phase. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check ingredient lists carefully as onion powder appears in many spice blends
Start with tiny amounts if reintroducing after elimination phase
Store in airtight container to maintain potency
Consider making your own spice blends to control FODMAP content
alternatives: Fresh herbs like oregano or thyme
